fixture_policy: committed signal_cards are local preview fixtures; default deploy fixtures exclude synthetic cards; production cards are generated on the server from FMZ signal_review.jsonl and optional LLM sidecar
frontend_contract: Manifest-first Chinese reader. One validated advisory result supplies suggestion, card-time price and price bias, per-side evidence grades and comparison, mechanisms and primary counters, conditional 4h/24h outlooks. Original signal windows and hard risks are a separate read-only explanation; guidance does not alter execution permissions. Selected-card lazy loading, existing filters and neutral-paper module order remain. Native 15/30m summaries and longer context are separate. Locally restored historical comparisons are hash-bound display projections and are never inserted into archived model evidence. Machine fields remain download-only.
reader_presentation: Neutral paper. Native GEX source clocks; spatial levels in dynamics; locally verified endpoint changes in the change skeleton.
